get.description:
Per-donor surplus forecasts (member 4's `forecast_surplus`). Suggestions
for coordinating pickups: they never create offers or reservations.

AnomalyItem.title: AnomalyItem
AnomalyItem.description: A positive residual anomaly on a supported restaurant observation.

ClusterCenter.title: ClusterCenter
ClusterCenter.description: Cluster center transformed back to interpretable source units.

ClusterItem.title: ClusterItem
ClusterItem.description: One non-singleton group of similar dish profiles.

production_cost_change_ron_per_service.title: Production Cost Change Ron Per Service

CurvePoint.title: CurvePoint
CurvePoint.description: Empirical outcome for one integer production quantity, per service.

DonorForecast.title: DonorForecast
DonorForecast.description: Forecast, evaluation and provenance for one donor.

ExplanationAvailability.title: ExplanationAvailability
ExplanationAvailability.description: Whether explanation computation completed, independent of findings.

ExplanationFactor.title: ExplanationFactor
ExplanationFactor.description: One globally aggregated model explanation factor.

ExplanationMethod.title: ExplanationMethod
ExplanationMethod.description: Methods that may produce public global explanation factors.

ExplanationsResult.title: ExplanationsResult
ExplanationsResult.description:
Explanation payload nested in a model result.

``ready`` with no factors means the method ran and found nothing reportable;
``unavailable`` means explanation computation did not produce a valid output.
The containing model result can remain ready in the latter case.

ForecastPoint.title: ForecastPoint
ForecastPoint.description: Predicted surplus for one donor on one future day, in the donor's unit.

ForecastResult.title: ForecastResult
ForecastResult.description: Result of ``forecast_surplus``. Suggestions for coordination, never offers.

ImpactResult.title: ImpactResult
ImpactResult.description: Only confirmed handovers count as impact, once per reservation.

ModelEvaluation.title: ModelEvaluation
ModelEvaluation.description: Held-out temporal evaluation reported in percentage points.

ModelResult.title: ModelResult
ModelResult.description: Result of ``analyze_model`` with evaluation and optional findings.

OfferCreate.title: OfferCreate
OfferCreate.description:
Request body for POST /offers. `allergens: null` means unknown and
blocks automatic matching. `location` defaults to the donor's location.

PatternItem.title: PatternItem
PatternItem.description: One supported association discovered by the pattern analysis.

PatternMetrics.title: PatternMetrics
PatternMetrics.description: Weighted metrics for a pattern group or its comparable baseline.

PatternSupport.title: PatternSupport
PatternSupport.description: Visible support behind a reported pattern.

RecommendationAction.title: RecommendationAction
RecommendationAction.description: One deterministic action linked to supplied pattern evidence.

SimulationResult.title: SimulationResult
SimulationResult.description: Result of ``simulate``. The curve is per service, never per month.

SimulationSelection.title: SimulationSelection
SimulationSelection.description: Simulator request: one dish, weekday, service and planned quantity.

SurplusLogCreate.title: SurplusLogCreate
SurplusLogCreate.description:
A donor's confirmation of its total surplus for one past or current day.

`quantity_kg: 0` is a confirmed zero-surplus day, which is different from a
day with no entry (unknown). This is the source of complete history for
forecasts.

TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow
TimeWindow.description: A local (Europe/Bucharest) opening interval within one day.
